name: Daisy Harding
source:
Daisy is the 10-year-old daughter of [url=/c64113]Brian[/url]. Based on what Brian discloses, she is incredibly smart but has trouble connecting with children around her age. During the dates with Brian, she and [url=/c73297]Amanda[/url] form a friendship and collectively dislike their parents' need to compete with each other.

[From the [url=https://dreamdaddy.fandom.com/wiki/Daisy]Wiki[/url].]
